title: crypto2dev: KEY fd lifecycle management
description: Manage KEY fds for asymmetric operations. Each wolfSSL ecc_key, RsaKey, or curve25519_key that uses the crypto2dev shim needs a corresponding KEY fd open for its lifetime. On key init/import: open /dev/crypto2dev, write key bytes, call KEY_IMPORT or KEY_GENERATE ioctl, store fd in key->devCtx. On key free (WC_ALGO_TYPE_FREE callback): close the fd and zero devCtx. Also handle KEY_GENERATE: after ioctl, read() public key back and import into the wolfSSL key struct. Thread safety: each key owns its fd exclusively (no sharing).
notes: Requires WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_FREE to be enabled (given for this shim). KEY fd is one-per-key, not pooled — asymmetric ops are infrequent and KEY fds are stateful. devCtx field on wolfSSL key structs (ecc_key, RsaKey) is the right place to store the fd.
